files.stock.mjs:
import {clamp} from './bounds.mjs';
export const available = (total,reserved) => clamp(total + reserved);
files.handlers.mjs:
import {remaining as remaining} from './stock.mjs';
export const handle = body => ({value:remaining(body.total,body.reserved)});
files.server.mjs:
import http from 'node:http';import {handle} from './handlers.mjs';
export const createApp = () => http.createServer(async(req,res)=>{try{let raw='';for await(const c of req)raw+=c;res.setHeader('content-type','application/json');res.end(JSON.stringify(handle(JSON.parse(raw))));}catch{res.statusCode=400;res.end('{}');}});
